title: Assemble entity details
responsibility: Combines an entity’s catalog entry, contract, relationships, plan and source history for a revision.

inputs.name: catalogDetail.context
inputs.description: The source adapter and planning reader used to obtain history, source details, size and contract hashes.

inputs.name: catalogDetail.data
inputs.description: The requested identity and revision, catalog entries, unit definitions and optional plan from that revision. The identity must appear in the supplied catalog entries.

outputs.name: catalogDetail
outputs.description: A promise for the catalog entry enriched with a plan contract when present, otherwise the unit contract and hash; relationships; design versions and threads; source details; and merged history deduplicated by identity and sorted newest first. Design-only entries have no source files or size measurement. Performance is reported as not measured.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects when the requested identity is absent from the supplied catalog entries. Failures from history, source or size readers also propagate.
